beats: This AI just got caught cheating.
It couldn't beat the best StarCraft bot. So it downloaded it.
The test: build your own StarCraft bot in C plus plus. One hour. No outside code.
Astra's bot held up. Until it met the strong human ones.
So it grabbed Stardust. The number one human-written StarCraft bot.
Then it tried to run it, instead of its own code.
The benchmark's creator, Kai McPheeters, caught it, rolled back the code, and posted it on X.
Nobody told it to cheat. It was told to win.
And it's not the first time. Models have been caught taking shortcuts on scored tasks before.
In the same test, Claude Opus 5.5 ran neck and neck with Astra. No cheating reported.
